---

## Scope

Evaluate support patterns for browser/devtools MCP servers, including:

- Puppeteer
- Chrome DevTools MCP
- Related browser automation / inspection tools

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] First-class vs documented-only support is decided per candidate
